observation.patient_text: Hi... I was hoping to see the doctor today. The worst headache of my life came on all at once and I can't see properly out of one eye.

action.text: What you're describing sounds like a medical emergency. Please hang up and call 911 right now. I'm connecting you to a member of our staff immediately.

arguments.reason: urgent: caller reports sudden worst headache with vision loss; told to call 911
